assessments.reasoning: At §2.9, printed p. 2-7, the 1968 DEC manual distinguishes immediate execution from storing a line prefixed by a number. It gives the inclusive range 1.01 through 15.99, treats 1.00, 2.00 and analogous numbers as whole-group designators, and names the component to the right of the point the step.

challenge.method: Compared the exact section with the CHM-linked technical specifications, printed p. 1-2, and the January 1970 manual §2.9.
challenge.results: The linked DEC specifications also describe 1.01 through 15.99 and a nonzero step. The January 1970 manual expressly changes the stated upper bound to 31.99. The documented numeric bounds remain distinct by edition.

limitations: The lower and upper stated bounds have nonzero steps. The range is subject to the zero-step reservation and the documented indirect line-number syntax of this 1968 manual.
